sections.text: Spell to Create a Field of Flowers

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 270. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Recovers 20% of max HP when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Only [Magic Collector] Frieren can be used as Unlocking Potential material
